objectives.title: Domain Admin
objectives.prompt: Compromise the cs.org domain, reach Domain Admin and read C:\ctf\flag.txt on dc01.
hints: Start anonymously: enumerate users and their attributes over LDAP and SMB.
User attributes and shared passwords give a first account; Kerberos then offers more.
Map the ACLs and group memberships (BloodHound) and look for replication rights or a privileged group that loads code into a service.

steps.title: Name the domain
steps.prompt: What is the DNS name of the Active Directory domain?

steps.title: Leaky attribute
steps.prompt: Which user attribute in this lab sometimes holds a password in clear text?

steps.title: Roast a service
steps.prompt: Which attack requests Kerberos service tickets for accounts that have an SPN, then cracks them offline?

steps.title: No pre-authentication
steps.prompt: Which attack collects crackable material for accounts that have Kerberos pre-authentication disabled?

steps.title: Abuse a group
steps.prompt: Membership of which built-in group lets a user make the DNS service load a DLL of their choice?

steps.title: Replicate the secrets
steps.prompt: Which technique uses directory replication rights to pull every account's password hash from the domain controller?
